title: feat(research): release the T148 restore composition
body:
## Summary

```diff

+ T148+R1: kappa = 0.001729152337142958365650 - 10^-46 - 10^-70
```

The exact conditional gain is `283289984980663/250000000000000000000000`, about `1.13316e-9`. Only admission's order, fill and dispatch arguments change. All 543,456 roles, the paid rank-32 remainder, 91 private buffers and 133,117 physical families remain charged. The doubled stock raises its norm charge by one bit; the rederived reserve is 1511, below the retained 2048-bit payload.

[Proof, exact source pins, receipts and reproduction](https://github.com/petalas/integer-mult-bounds/tree/9d10633660a3dff5469f4e7a0a009a6c9994c0d7/research/rank7-t148-restore-release). - **Before:** PR3021 releases R1 plus T74 packing; PR3022's T148 result has no composed supplier/outer release. **After:** a fresh 1494.85-second source/bootstrap/native/owners/admission/modern-outer chain passes at the larger point. Both changed native providers run freshly. The final source/payload/cap/invoice postchecks pass against those completed artifacts and the same normalized scientific recipe.
- The actual strict invoice confirms 1332 local sweeps and 1332 bridges, stock-norm exponent 1323, native prefix 93 and global prefix 1476. Source-specific and broader paid-profile packing caps are reported, not confused with integral optimality.
- Registered Python 3.12 replay passes 13 behavioral tests and ten receipt/actual-invoice rejection controls. Optimized replay, Python 3.13 finite equality, warnings-as-errors, Ruff and all 58 committed/input byte checks pass locally. Hosted CI is separate.

```sh
python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py \
```

R1 credit remains with Jeremy Kothe; PR3018/3022's packing and PR3021's release driver remain credited to Nick Petalas. The underlying joint construction is Marius-Paul Dumitrean's PR2979, retaining the Hale, Diviney, Lu, Tekalign, Richardson, Dugongue, icekylinx, themilkman216 and source lineage. Substantial automated assistance was used; no independent human or formal-kernel review is claimed. Apache-2.0.

This is an author-checked conditional finite construction. All-size/compiler, physical backing/movement, precision/tape, analytic and universal block-energy hypotheses remain inherited. The selected frontier is unchanged. PR3024's T740 cap attainment and active R1/admission follow-up have a distinct, larger-stock scope.
